reviews.comment: The quizzes and exams have a very strict time limit. I remember on a 15-question quiz I only had 17 mins to take it. He answers emails very quickly but is not lenient. lots of reading is required for this course if you want to understand the content. There are video lectures but they are not that helpful.

Professor Leathe was great. He always responded to emails quickly, and seemed to genuinely care about his students. He gives multiple extra credit oppurtunities to regain points after exams. The exams can be difficult but they are open note. If you take good notes, the exams are a breeze!
